locations.note: The car crashes in Central Park, where the dying Theo hands Carnby the Stone; the night ends in the hidden chamber beneath the park, where Lucifer's portal waits.
Carnby wakes with no memory in a collapsing Manhattan building and escapes with Sarah Flores and Theo Paddington by car through streets torn open by supernatural fissures.
In Room 943 Theo's ghost tells Carnby the Stone's history, and Sarah stays behind to study his notes until Crowley kidnaps her.
Carnby trails the Path of Light deep beneath the castle to the underground temple where the alchemist Hermes Treismajice guards the other half of the Stone.

routes.name: Carnby's night in New York
routes.note: From a collapsing Manhattan building through Central Park and the Met to the alchemists' temple under Belvedere Castle, and back with Hermes to the chamber where Lucifer's portal opens.
